question: Which of the following glomerulopathies is the most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly?
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Membranous glomerulonephritis -> most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly -> 80% CHAIN: Diabetic nephropathy -> common cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly -> 70% CHAIN: Kidney Amyloidosis -> less common cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly -> 80%
enhanced_information: Membranous glomerulonephritis is the most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly, with diabetic nephropathy also being a common cause. Kidney amyloidosis is a less common cause in this age group. Evidence supports the role of diabetic nephropathy in causing nephrotic syndrome.
analysis: Membranous glomerulonephritis is the most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly, with diabetic nephropathy also being a common cause. Kidney amyloidosis is a less common cause in this age group. While diabetic nephropathy is a common cause of nephrotic syndrome, membranous glomerulonephritis is the most frequent cause in the elderly population.
